content.short: A multi layered NFT project across planets, landscape views and aliens who occupy these worlds.
content.description:
At the highest level of the AdaverseX is the Goguen Galaxy comprising of 500 stars, planets and asteroids depicted with unique art. Many planets have been named after key actors who are central to building the Cardano smart-contract ecosystem. The next level of AdaverseX planets have worlds views or scenes from planets across the Goguen Galaxy.

There is a maximum supply of 1,250 planets landscapes. AdverseX has been populated with a diverse range of the alien species populated which have a max supply of 3,000 in the Goguen Galaxy.
